mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

The project's current recorded decision is to use argon2id as the password hashing algorithm, chosen because its memory-hard design makes hashed passwords much harder to crack. No specific parameters (memory cost, iterations, parallelism, salt length) are recorded, so none are specified here.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

It is about certificate verification on dev builds, so it doesn't affect this one. The file doesn't mention the retired algorithm.

My first attempt to write the file through the shell failed, so I wrote it with the file tool instead. I haven't committed it.
